pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #17 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A picture shows a father, but the label says 妈妈. Is the pair right or wrong? (1 mark)
   A. Wrong, 对
   B. Right, 对
   C. Right, 错
   D. Wrong, 错

2. Which sentence means "This is my older sister."? (1 mark)
   A. 那是我弟弟。
   B. 我爱你。
   C. 这是我姐姐。
   D. 这是我爸爸。

3. What does 厕所 (cèsuǒ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Garden
   B. Toilet
   C. Is at, is in
   D. Left side

4. Which sentence means "Where is the television?"? (1 mark)
   A. 卧室里有床。
   B. 床在卧室。
   C. 电视在哪儿?
   D. 沙发在门旁边。

5. What does 教堂 (jiàotáng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tomorrow
   B. Yesterday
   C. Mosque
   D. Church

6. What does 星期六 (xīngqīliù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Saturday
   B. Church
   C. Three
   D. Eight

7. What does 大家 (dàjiā) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Everybody
   B. We
   C. Month
   D. They

8. What does 生日 (shēngrì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Birthday
   B. Happy
   C. Cake
   D. To come

9. Which sentence means "For breakfast I eat bǐng."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是香蕉。
   B. 我早饭吃饼。
   C. 我喝茶。
   D. 我喜欢吃香蕉。

10. Read the pinyin: zhè shì shénme? What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like to eat bananas.
   B. What is this?
   C. I drink tea.
   D. For breakfast I eat bǐng.

11. What does 脚 (jiǎo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To use
   B. Head
   C. Shoulder
   D. Foot

12. Which sentence means "I use my mouth to speak."? (1 mark)
   A. 我用耳朵听。
   B. 我有两只眼睛。
   C. 我用嘴巴说。
   D. 我用眼睛看。

13. How long is the pause at a full stop compared with a comma? (1 mark)
   A. The same
   B. Shorter
   C. Longer
   D. There is no pause

14. Which Chinese word means "not"? (1 mark)
   A. 不 bù
   B. 很 hěn
   C. 干旱 gānhàn
   D. 也 yě

15. What does 早上 zǎoshang mean? (1 mark)
   A. Evening
   B. Afternoon
   C. Night
   D. Morning

16. What does 下面 (xiàmiàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Bathroom
   B. Table
   C. Below
   D. Fridge

17. Which stroke goes from top to bottom? (1 mark)
   A. 捺 nà
   B. 横 héng
   C. 竖 shù
   D. 提 tí

18. How many strokes does the character 大 have? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 4
   C. 2
   D. 3

19. Which word for a family member has 女 at the start? (1 mark)
   A. 儿子
   B. 爸爸
   C. 女儿
   D. 弟弟

20. What does 弟弟 (dìdi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Who
   B. Older sister
   C. Younger brother
   D. Younger sister

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Read and translate the chant line: 风来了,雨来了,雪也来了。 (3 marks)

22. Write in Chinese with pinyin: "I like to drink tea." (2 marks)

23. Explain the job of the apostrophe in the word nǚ'ér. (2 marks)

24. Give the Chinese for mosque and church with pinyin. (2 marks)

25. Arrange the words to make a sentence and translate: 礼物 / 送 / 朋友 / 我. (3 marks)

26. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 听 and 雨. (2 marks)

27. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my mother." (2 marks)

28. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wòshì lǐ yǒu chuáng. (2 marks)

29. Write the eight basic strokes' names in Chinese with pinyin. Any six earn full marks. (3 marks)

30. Write the difference between a statement and a question when reading aloud, with an example. (3 marks)

31. What is the main idea of a text and what are details? Give a short example. (3 marks)

32. Explain what stress is in reading aloud and give an example. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #17 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Wrong, 错
   妈妈 is mother, not father.

2. C — 这是我姐姐。
   这是我姐姐。 (zhè shì wǒ jiějie.) means "This is my older sister.".

3. B — Toilet
   厕所 (cèsuǒ) means toilet.

4. C — 电视在哪儿?
   电视在哪儿? (diànshì zài nǎr?) means "Where is the television?".

5. D — Church
   教堂 (jiàotáng) means church.

6. A — Saturday
   星期六 (xīngqīliù) means Saturday.

7. A — Everybody
   大家 (dàjiā) means everybody.

8. A — Birthday
   生日 (shēngrì) means birthday.

9. B — 我早饭吃饼。
   我早饭吃饼。 (wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng.) means "For breakfast I eat bǐng.".

10. B — What is this?
   zhè shì shénme? is 这是什么?, which means "What is this?".

11. D — Foot
   脚 (jiǎo) means foot.

12. C — 我用嘴巴说。
   我用嘴巴说。 (wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō.) means "I use my mouth to speak.".

13. C — Longer
   A full stop needs a longer pause.

14. A — 不 bù
   不 (bù) means not.

15. D — Morning
   早上 is morning.

16. C — Below
   下面 (xiàmiàn) means below.

17. C — 竖 shù
   竖 is the vertical stroke.

18. D — 3
   大 has 横, 撇 and 捺.

19. C — 女儿
   女儿 is daughter.

20. C — Younger brother
   弟弟 (dìdi) means younger brother.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Fēng lái le, yǔ lái le, xuě yě lái le. The wind has come, the rain has come, the snow has come too.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for pinyin, 2 marks for meaning.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我喜欢喝茶。 wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: It shows where one syllable ends and the next begins, nǚ + ér.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part of the explanation.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: 清真寺 qīngzhēnsì and 教堂 jiàotáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: 朋友送我礼物。 My friend gives me a gift.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for the translation.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: 听: tīng, to listen, to hear. 雨: yǔ, rain.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是我妈妈。 zhè shì wǒ māma.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: There is a bed in the bedroom.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: 横 héng, 竖 shù, 撇 piě, 捺 nà, 点 diǎn, 提 tí, 横折 héngzhé, 竖钩 shùgōu.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two, 2 marks for four, 3 marks for six or more.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: A statement ends a little lower, like 电视在客厅。 A question ends a little higher, like 电视在哪儿? Every syllable keeps its tone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each and 1 mark for keeping the tones.

31. (3 marks)
   Answer: The main idea is what the whole text is about, for example "my home". Details are facts that support it, for example "there is a sofa in the living room".
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for main idea, 1 mark for details, 1 mark for the example.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stress means saying an important word a little stronger. For example in 我们切蛋糕, you may stress 蛋糕 to show what we cut. It does not change the tone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for an example, 1 mark for the tone note.
